name: Axiomatic Px86 (Px86axiom)
description: Cho et al.'s declarative Intel-x86 persistency model, which simplifies and fixes documented flaws in Raad et al.'s Px86. Formally, they prove (Thm 4.3) that Px86axiom is equivalent to SPx86, a strengthening of Px86 that executes clflush synchronously, and (Thm 5.3) that it is equivalent to the operational Px86view. The crash-free behaviour coincides with x86-TSO.

catSupport.note: Declarative persistency axioms over x86-TSO executions; cat-shaped, but herd7 has no persist/crash events to express them over.
